parameters.name: column
parameters.description: A column from a related table on the one-side of a relationship.
parameters.examNote: The relationship must exist in the model. RELATED traverses from the many-side to the one-side (fact → dimension).

returnType: Scalar (the matching value from the related table for the current row)
summary: RELATED retrieves a value from a related dimension table, following the relationship from the many-side (fact) to the one-side (dimension). Used in calculated columns to bring in dimension attributes.

examples.label: Bring Category from Products into Sales
examples.explanation: RELATED follows the Sales→Products relationship on ProductID to retrieve the Category for each row. This works because each Sales row maps to exactly one Products row.

commonTraps: RELATED only works from the many-side to the one-side — you cannot use it inside a dimension table to look up fact data (use RELATEDTABLE for that).
RELATED can only be used in calculated columns or inside iterators (SUMX, FILTER) — not in regular measures where there is no row context.
If the relationship does not exist or is inactive, RELATED returns BLANK.
